entities.summary: Candy Gourlay is a Filipino journalist and author based in the United Kingdom whose debut novel Tall Story (2010) was shortlisted for the Carnegie Medal. Candy Gourlay was a authors & novelists from Davao City (b. 1962-04-19, Davao City). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Its legacy: Created literary works of enduring influence.
